Messages.Author: Martin Tibor Major
Messages.Body:
Hi LSJ!

If I remember right your ruling said that Enkil Cog untaps if the
announced action cards gets DI-d. How's it if the action gots canceled
with Tangle Atropos Hand?

Thanks in advance,

Martin

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Sep 29, 6:02 pm, Martin Tibor Major <major.martin.ti...@gmail.com>
wrote:

> Hi LSJ!
>
> If I remember right your ruling said that Enkil Cog untaps if the
> announced action cards gets DI-d. How's it if the action gots canceled
> with Tangle Atropos Hand?

Quite different.

The action has been attempted (a block has even been attempted on it),
so the Enkil Cog's "during X, do Y" is used up.

The vampire untaps and takes the action card back and, if xe can
manage it via Madness Network or something, gets +1 stealth on his
next turn. But he cannot attempt another action via the Cog this turn.
